normal: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: one standalone transparent 2D weapon sprite for Denti, a friendly glossy cartoon dental arena game. Input image 1 is the exact Pflanzstab (planting staff) of the class Kräuterzahn; use it as the ONLY subject and preserve its identity: a slender warm-brown wooden staff with two gold ferrules and teal inlays, a pointed gold dibber tip at the lower end, a curled living root head at the upper end holding one glowing seed with a tiny sprouting leaf, and a thin green vine wrapped around the upper third. Portrait 1024 x 1536 pixel canvas with true transparent RGBA background. The staff runs diagonally from the lower left (tip near x=0.14, y=0.86) to the upper right (root head near x=0.80, y=0.20), grip on the wood near (0.36, 0.62). Keep the same painterly volume, warm highlights and clean dark outlines, readable at 60px. No background, no ground shadow, no particles outside the silhouette, no text. Normal unenchanted form, exactly as the reference, only reframed onto the portrait canvas. Match the reference as closely as possible. Reframe the existing artwork for portrait aspect while preserving all its painted details and original proportions. Make room around the entire object and maintain real transparent alpha. This exact placement will be the rig reference for the other six skins.
